prompt: Some people believe that young people today are too dependent on technology such as computers, tablets, and cell phones. Others disagree and believe that technology is beneficial for young people's development. state your opinion
essay:
Some people might argue that teenagers nowadays rely too heavily on technology, whereas others believe that technology has some benefits in education for teenagers. In my view, technology has both benefits and drawbacks. It can make learning easier and offers a variety of ways to learn, but teenagers can easily be distracted by notifications.

Spending a significant amount of time on technology has some effects on teenagers, such as dry eyes. Dry eyes can develop when people do not blink regularly, and they may cause pain or discomfort. Moreover, teenagers can easily be distracted by discomfort or by their phones. For example, a teenager may be studying when they suddenly receive a message from a friend. They start chatting and never finish revising for the exam. This can lead to lower grades, which may affect their future opportunities. Some have become so dependent on technology that they struggle with simple tasks without it, such as basic calculations or spelling without autocorrect.

However, when used properly, technology can be a powerful tool for education. Technology offers a variety of ways to learn. For example, a teenager who does not understand their teacher's explanation can search online for the same lesson. They can also pause the video at any time, which makes learning more flexible. This can stop them from giving up on school, as they realise the problem was the teacher's explanation rather than their own ability.

In conclusion, technology has both benefits and drawbacks for teenagers. It makes learning more flexible and accessible, but it can also harm their health and distract them from their studies, so it should be used in moderation.
